about.title: I take responsibility for the system around the feature.
about.lead: I’m a senior full-stack engineer and Engineering Team Lead who works across product decisions, interfaces, back-end architecture, infrastructure, and delivery.
body: At Ninthroot, I progressed from student developer to Engineering Team Lead. My work has expanded from shipping web experiences to owning the capabilities behind them: a PHP framework and CMS, integrations, deployment workflows, business-continuity systems, and the engineering practices a small team relies on.

I’m most useful when a problem crosses boundaries. I can trace an issue from the user experience through application code, data, infrastructure, and team process, then choose a practical improvement that fits the business.
Outside that production work, I’m rebuilding an operations-platform concept with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL to keep sharpening my 0→1 product and architecture skills.
I earned a B.S. in Computer Science from Utah Valley University with Summa Cum Laude honors.

impact.title: Platform ownership

impact.description: I have shipped reusable systems, built proofs of concept, and recommended against deployment when operating cost or build-versus-buy tradeoffs did not hold up.
